usedFor: Shopify holds your products and orders, and 3Dsellers receives each new product through “Create product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create product” in 3Dsellers
bestTemplate.why: A product added in Shopify is added to your 3Dsellers store too, so both catalogs match.

watchOut: “New Product” only fires on creation, so edits to a Shopify product do not reach 3Dsellers.
